milton_historian: One who relates past events, here Raphael narrating creation.
milton_abstracted: Drawn away from ordinary outward sensation, as in a trance.
milton_instinctive: Arising from an inward natural impulse, Adam’s first bodily movement.
milton_supple_body: Readily flexible in the joints, distinct from political compliance.
milton_inure: Accustom by repeated practice, the angels’ prompt obedience.
milton_interspersing: Place passages between other parts of a discourse.
milton_scribble: Mark with hurried or confused written diagrams, the projected astronomical models.
milton_imbue: Permeate or infuse throughout, words imbued with grace.
milton_timing: Appropriate to the time or occasion of asking.
milton_plant_nursery: A tended place where plants are raised, Eve’s fruits and flowers; not training children.
milton_proof_resistant: Resistant enough to sustain an influence, Adam’s claim about beauty’s power; not logical demonstration.
milton_unbuild: Take an imagined construction apart, here revising astronomical models.
milton_colure: One of the great celestial circles through the poles, traversed in Satan’s circling journey.
milton_imp_instrument: An instrument or agent of fraud, the serpent as Satan’s chosen vessel; not a newly invented child demon.
milton_extenuate: Represent the transgression as less serious, as Adam does before eating.
milton_fortitude: Courageous steadfast endurance, especially patience and martyrdom.
milton_martyrdom: Death borne as a witness to faith or allegiance, contrasted with martial slaughter.
milton_seneschal: The household officer presiding over the feast; distinct from the officer serving dishes.
milton_tinsel: Glittering metallic textile ornament in the tournament trappings.
milton_tournament: A formal mounted martial contest, distinct from the individual joust.
milton_colloquial_expression: Outward expressive gesture, including the serpent’s mute gestures before speaking.
milton_serpent_crest: The elevated crowning ridge of Milton’s imagined upright serpent, not a fowl’s comb or heraldic device.
milton_tree_trunk: The main woody body of a tree, around which the serpent claims to climb.
milton_wile: A deliberate deceptive device or trick, including the serpent’s persuasion.
milton_harbinger: A forerunner announcing what follows, misery before death.
milton_specious: Plausibly good in appearance, capable of misleading judgment.
milton_irresolute: Not yet settled on a course of action.
milton_incarnate: Enter or embody an essence in flesh.
milton_imbrute: Take on the bodily condition of an animal, Satan’s self-abasement.
milton_dress_garden: Tend and put a garden in good order, not clothe it.
milton_leniency: Permissive leniency blamed by Adam, not an ecclesiastical remission.
milton_dispute: Contentious reciprocal argument, the couple’s fruitless contest.
milton_conspicuous: Conspicuous above other examples, the supposed proof of love.
milton_savour: Relish or taste in Adam’s taste-and-judgment wordplay.
milton_elegant: Discriminating and refined, the purported good taste Adam praises.
milton_articulate: Distinctly formed speech sounds, as opposed to mute animal voice.
milton_dictate: Give words or directives to another, of the Muse or misleading reason.
milton_proem: The introductory speech of the tempter, his opening flattery.
milton_relax_body: Bodily joints lose their firmness under shock.
milton_dairy: The rural place or produce of milk husbandry in the sensory comparison.
milton_ted: Spread mown grass to dry, retaining the agricultural detail.
milton_sewer_drain: A city drain, distinct from the table officer called a sewer.
milton_rustle: The light sound made by moving leaves.
milton_flush_red: A reddening glow in Eve’s cheek after eating.
milton_lower_frown: The sky grows threatening and dark, not physical lowering.
milton_forebode: Feel apprehension of impending harm, Adam’s faltering heart.
milton_concupiscence: Sexual lust made visible in the fallen pair, retaining the theological register.
milton_rapine_delight: Delight figuratively robbing the spectator of hostile intent, the sweet rapine image.
milton_intoxicate: Be overcome as by wine; the fruit’s effect on the pair.
milton_compact_material: Condense or combine matter into a close mass, not form a political covenant.
milton_asphodel: The named pale flowering plant in the lovers’ floral couch; source category retained.
milton_oread: A mountain nymph in the comparison with Eve.
milton_dryad: A tree nymph in the comparison with Eve.
milton_imprese: A knight’s distinctive emblem or device, not merely any pattern.
milton_speculation: Consideration of high or deep matters in the serpent’s claimed intellectual awakening.
milton_outgrow: Grow beyond the workers’ capacity to keep pace.
milton_premeditate: Think or compose in advance, opposed to the narrator’s unpremeditated verse.
milton_voracious: Greedy consumption of food, distinct from avarice for wealth.
milton_condolence: Eve’s expression of shared grief to Adam.
milton_attraction_force: The drawing force felt by Sin, distinct from beauty or personal charm.
milton_connive: Appear knowingly to overlook or tolerate misconduct.
milton_contumacy: Obstinate defiance of authority, in Adam’s objection to self-destruction.
milton_conception_child: The beginning of pregnancy, distinct from intellectual conception or the formation of matter.
milton_colleague: A fellow worker, here Mercy personified as Justice’s colleague.
milton_collision: Contact in which bodies strike against each other.
milton_causeway: The raised roadway across the abyss, a solid work rather than a ford.
milton_mole: A massive built embankment or pier, not an animal or a skin mark.
milton_shoal_collect: Collect material into a shoal or bank, not a group of fish.
milton_offal: The discarded foul material consumed by the personified hell-hounds.
milton_draff: Refuse or dregs, used alongside filth and offal in the cleansing image.
milton_filth: Foul material or moral pollution, retaining the concrete cleaning image.
milton_temper_disposition: Disposition, especially the judge’s mild temper; not the tempering of metal or air.
milton_mitigate: Lessen the severity of a sentence without cancelling it.
milton_reflux: A returning flow, the curses of descendants returning to their source.
milton_quadrature: The square heavenly domain contrasted with the circular created world.
milton_trident: The three-pronged spear in the freezing-of-the-sea comparison.
milton_sextile: The astrological sixty-degree aspect, a sixth of the circle.
milton_square_aspect: The astrological ninety-degree relation, not a plaza or physical board.
milton_trine: The astrological one-hundred-twenty-degree relation, a third of the circle.
milton_conjunction: The coming together of celestial bodies in the historical astrology described.
milton_solstitial: Pertaining to the sun’s seasonal turning point.
milton_tropic: The celestial turning limit at Cancer or Capricorn.
milton_amphisbaena: The traditional two-ended serpent of the classical catalogue.
milton_cerastes: The horned serpent named in the classical catalogue.
milton_hydrus: The water-serpent category named in the classical catalogue.
milton_ellops: The classical named serpent Ellops; mute-serpent follows its historical name, without identifying a modern species.
milton_dipsas: The thirst-serpent of the classical catalogue, retaining its traditional distinction.
milton_pin_fastener: A solid fastening pin used with chains to anchor the bridge.
milton_patry: The paternal inheritance, bitterly applied to the transmitted curse.
milton_transmigrate: Move to inhabit another realm, the migration out of Hell.
milton_spatter: Expel in scattered small drops or particles.
milton_sniff: Draw air through the nose to detect the smell of prey.
milton_squall: A sudden violent gust, the source’s stormy flaw.
milton_fork_v: Divide into prongs, used for the serpents’ tongues.
milton_incestuous: Sexual intercourse within the prohibited kinship, describing Sin as Death’s mother.
milton_convict: Prove guilty; distinct from imposing the sentence itself.
milton_conviction: Proof of guilt, including Adam’s reasoning that returns to his own culpability.
milton_allusion: An indirect reference by likeness, here Lucifer and the bright star.
milton_antipathy: Natural mutual aversion that introduces predation among beasts.
milton_oratory: The art of public eloquent speech, contrasted with unuttered prayer.
milton_asthma: The historical disease category of difficult or constricted breathing in the catalogue.
milton_atrophy: The wasting or failure of nourishment named in the historical catalogue; separate from marasmus.
milton_marasmus: The wasting-away condition named alongside atrophy; preserves the separate historical category.
milton_calculus: An internal bodily stone, not a counting calculus or external rock.
milton_catarrh: The historical flowing discharge called catarrh, distinct from the jointly racking rheums.
milton_spasm: A sudden involuntary muscular contraction in the illness catalogue.
milton_convulsion: An involuntary violent shaking of the body, distinct from the separately named epilepsies.
milton_rheum: The historical flowing humoral disorder here tormenting the joints, not merely tears.
milton_ulcer: An open sore in the historical internal disease catalogue.
milton_fugue: Musical voices entering in imitation, figured as fleeing and pursuing one another.
milton_chime: A harmonious sounding together of the instruments.
milton_symphony: Harmonious instrumental sounds in the celebration, not necessarily the later orchestral form.
milton_eyebright: The plant Euphrasy applied to Adam’s visual nerve; a distinct source plant name.
milton_lazarhouse: A house accommodating the sick in the vision, not the proper name Lazarus.
milton_qualm: A physical fit of faintness or nausea in the historical disease list, not a moral scruple.
milton_midriff: The middle bodily region into which the stone strikes.
milton_film_eye: The obscuring membrane formed over sight by the forbidden fruit.
milton_orc_sea: The large marine creature of the historical sea-monster category, not a land-dwelling fantasy humanoid.
milton_seamew: The gull-like sea bird of the source, with its audible cry.
milton_landmark: A marker dividing or locating land; here the rustic altar.
milton_woof: The crosswise threads of woven cloth.
milton_nerve: The bodily channel or cord of sensation, here visual; distinct from courage.
milton_depopulation: The removal of a region’s human population by death in the Flood.
milton_chersonese: The historical Golden Chersonese, rendered as a native geographical epithet.
milton_dejection: Downcast spirits, separately named between sorrow and despair.
milton_transition: A transition from one part of the narrated history to the next.
milton_arrogate: Claim authority without rightful entitlement, specifically over fellow people.
milton_appropriate: Take or claim as exclusively one’s own, here the Spirit promised to all believers.
milton_breath_relief: The day of respiration: relief and renewed breathing for the just.
milton_depravity: The natural moral corruption the law is said to disclose.
milton_emboss: Raise swellings on the skin, in the bodily plague image.
milton_evangelize: Proclaim the good news to the nations, retaining the particular missionary act.
milton_infallible: Claimed incapable of error; the source questions claims against conscience.
milton_intrusion: An unwelcome entry or encroachment, here of the plague creatures.
milton_jangle: A discordant clash of unintelligible words.
milton_hubbub: The noisy confusion among the builders.
milton_lineage_stock: The ancestral stock from which descendants proceed, retaining the root image.
milton_temporal: Limited to time, contrasted with immortal life; not merely an adverb then.
milton_scriptural_type: An anticipatory figure in scriptural rites; distinct from the truth it foreshadows.
